notes.title: Update 2.0!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Changelog:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Player controller reworked for more pleasant experience
[*] Level 79 «Sniper» - no more annoying tiny hitboxes! No you can easily shoot ‘em all without any misses (and of course get achievement for that)
[*] Completely changed Level 69 «Layers»
[*] Redesigned levels with clones — level 7 «Only You», level 38 «Mirror» and level 76 «Helper». ([url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1wR0c548kZI]watch video walkthrough[/url])
[*] Rhythm game on level 57 «Dance» is changed
[*] Improved draw mechanic on level 6 «Draw»
[*] Minor changes on levels: 39 «Cyclops», 49 «Moon», 59 «Buttons», 57 «Red»
[*] Bugs fixed
[*] Added easter egg by Xorven
[/list]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1wR0c548kZI]Video walkthrough[/url]
